name: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
summary: Far to the south, Keeper Albagorm looks for help to restore the Charred Vale. The Bloodfury harpies have been driven back for now, but force alone cannot heal the wounded land.

sections.title: The Scars of the Vale
sections.body: Ash covers the Charred Vale in southern Stonetalon Mountains, where terrible destruction has scarred the land. Alliance forces under Keeper Albagorm drove the Bloodfury harpies from their nests in the ruins, but the harpies may return. Force can only hold them back. The ravaged earth must heal before they come back to claim the Vale.

sections.title: A Plea to the South
sections.body: The grove tenders cannot restore the scorched land alone. So Keeper Albagorm sends you south, past the salt flats and canyons of Thousand Needles, to Thalanaar on the border of Feralas. Falfindel Waywarder waits there. The night elf druid is known for a rare gift: calling ancient forest spirits to bring life back to dead soil.

faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm tends the grove at Stonetalon Peak. He oversees Alliance efforts to cleanse and restore the blighted Charred Vale.
Falfindel Waywarder is at Thalanaar, on the western border where Thousand Needles meets Feralas.

faq.q: Why send for a druid all the way in Feralas?
faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm believes Falfindel can summon ancient forest spirits strong enough to heal the deep damage in the Charred Vale.

faq.q: What threat resides in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: Hostile Bloodfury harpies, fire elementals, and wild beasts live in the valley, thriving in the wake of its burning.
No combat is required. You carry Keeper Albagorm's message across central and southern Kalimdor.

faq.q: How do you reach Thousand Needles from Stonetalon?
aliases: how to get to thousand needles
faq.answer: From Stonetalon Mountains, travel east into the Barrens, then south along the Gold Road. Take the Great Lift down into Thousand Needles, then continue west toward Feralas.

angles.text: As a druid, you share the Cenarion duty to reach beyond local garrisons and call on primal nature spirits to heal lands scarred by unnatural ruin.
As an Alliance member, you rely on Stonetalon Peak's foothold and the links between frontier outposts across Kalimdor's vast, contested reaches.
